newsitem.title: USA: Transworld says stock deal falls through.
newsitem.headline: Transworld says stock deal falls through.

text.p: Transworld Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday that Pacific Telesis Group has terminated a purchase agreement.
The agreement was between Pacific Telesis, Transworld, Le Groupe Videotron Ltee and their affiliated companies.

Under an agreement dated November 6, Pacific Telesis had agreed to purchase all of the stock of Wireless Holdings Inc and Videotron (Bay Area) Inc, which own wireless cable rights and certain operating wireless cable systems on the West Coast and in Tampa, Fla., and Greenville, S.C.
Transworld owns 50 percent of Wireless Holdings and 20 percent of Videotron Bay Area. Le Groupe Videotron owns 80 percent of Videotron Bay Area.
The agreement allowed the termination of the deal by any of the parties after November 9, as long as it had complied with all its obligations.
No reason was given for the termination of the deal.
